docs.text: Welcome to WhiskDB Docs Note! This page is still under construction, please do not consider the information provided for now. This is the official project documentation for WhiskDB , a database engine designed to run application code directly within the database engine itself. Project Overview Traditional architectures separate the database and the application layer with network boundaries. Each query incurs round-trip serialization and network overhead. WhiskDB eliminates this boundary by co-locating business logic and state in the same physical memory space. Inspired by modern data systems such as SpacetimeDB and Convex , WhiskDB combines the speed of in-memory execution with durable persistence and real-time client reactivity. Academic Information This project is conducted as part of the Senior Capstone Graduation Project at OSTİM Technical University .
